title: Replace the single-source x0.30 value haircut with value-kept + uncertainty-carried, tested against outcomes
current_system: Single-source haircut (non-pick row resting on one post-Hampel family keeps 30% of its blend)
status: live (incumbent); challenger flag-OFF, failed preregistered gate G2c
current_method: Deterministic multiplicative penalty on value when one family votes; confidence also LOW
evidence: Owner decision B (docs/valuation/VALUATION_ADVANCEMENT_MAP_2026-09-30.md V2-6) rejects 'one family => 30% of the estimate'; docs/valuation/evidence/sparse-evidence-2026-10-01/README.md: 7/8 gates pass, G2c fails (median challenger/incumbent 3.335 vs ceiling 2.0) because G2c measured distance from the haircut, not accuracy; shadow ledger src/api/sparse_evidence_shadow.py collects outcome evidence (box-local, gitignored). Constant 0.30 has NO empirical support in repo.
baseline: Strong simple baseline: keep the single family's observation unchanged (no haircut) with LOW confidence + interval; incumbent x0.30; challenger C (censor-bounded by absent families' published cutoffs)
proposed: Re-preregister C vs no-haircut vs incumbent with an OUTCOME target: later canonical value once >=2 families list the player (4- and 8-week horizons), proper loss on log value, rows that never gain a second family included; uncertainty moves to evidenceState + interval
principle: 9 nonignorable missingness (absence-from-board as censoring); 1 epistemic uncertainty
mechanism: A missing corroboration is not evidence of 70% lower value; an absent family whose board stops above the player bounds value from above (censoring), otherwise absence is uninformative. The haircut converts missing evidence into a value penalty, the pattern MISSING IS NEVER ZERO forbids in spirit.
data_available: Committed export archives (<= T0 for V2.1 sealing), CSV git history, sparse-evidence shadow ledger on box
data_missing: Enough single-family rows that later gain a second family (effective n unknown); box ledger not in repo
consumers: rankDerivedValue for ~50 deep rows; trade calculators, waiver/FAAB, roster value, BDVM universe
risk: Deep single-source rows may rise x3.3 and enter mid-board lists; G2a/G2b rank gates must carry over
evaluation: Point-in-time: prediction frozen at t0 from ledger records predating outcomes; outcome = first board where a 2nd family lists the player within horizon; loss = |log(est) - log(later)|; block bootstrap by week
acceptance: Candidate median abs log error lower than incumbent with 90% block-bootstrap CI excluding 0; G2a/G2b/G3/G4 pass; bound coverage (later value <= censor bound) >= 80%
rejection: No lift vs incumbent, or no lift vs no-haircut baseline (then prefer simpler no-haircut), or bound coverage < 60%, or any top-200 entry
effort: M (3-5 days after >=8 weeks of ledger accumulation)
related_roadmap: V2-6, Owner decision B (2026-10-01), Batch 3 Unit E, C10 prior census, F-MISS-01
novelty_note: Not novel inside repo (sparse-evidence lane exists); contribution is the explicit no-haircut strong baseline and outcome gate replacing G2c

title: Value revision-risk interval: an honest 'how much could this value move' band per asset
current_system: None. Values are point estimates; sourceSpread and confidenceBucket are diagnostics with no interval semantics
code_owner: New consumer-only module beside src/api/confidence.py; inputs from data_contract stamps (familyValues, confidenceAxes) and src/history as-of reads
evidence: AMATH D1 (scratchpad amath_val_d1.py; committed CSVs/site_raw via git show, t0 2026-07-20..09-14, h=28d, 8 offense sources): cross-family log-rank MAD at t0 has weak positive Spearman with |28-day consensus revision| (median 0.151 top-50, 0.157 ranks 51-150, 0.072 ranks 151-300; positive in 8/9, 8/9, 7/9 overlapping windows; turns <=0 in the 2026-09-07 window). Revision scale also jumps after the season starts (top-50 mean |dlogrank| 0.035-0.08 in Jul-Aug windows vs 0.19-0.27 for windows ending in Oct).
baseline: Empirical revision quantiles by rank band x season phase only (no disagreement term); between-family bootstrap interval only
proposed: Two-component band: (a) between-family uncertainty (weighted family bootstrap of the existing blend) and (b) temporal revision risk = empirical/adaptive-conformal quantile of |dlog value| over horizon h, stratified by rank band, asset class and season phase; published as 50/80% bands labelled uncalibrated until coverage is measured
principle: 8 calibration/conformal (exchangeability violated -> stratified/adaptive); 1 Bayesian epistemic uncertainty; 4 nonstationarity (season phase)
mechanism: Users and engines treat 3,286 and 3,300 as different; a band shows when they are not. D1 says disagreement alone is a weak predictor, so the band must be driven mainly by depth and season phase, with disagreement as a secondary term
data_available: CSV git history from 2026-04 (PIT), export archives from 2026-07-14, temporal ledger on box
data_missing: Less than one season; no prior in-season history; ledger not local
consumers: Display only at first (rankings, player profile, trade panels); later trade engines via a separately named field
risk: Bands that are too wide to use, or narrow bands presented as calibrated; must never alter rankDerivedValue
evaluation: Rolling origin; for each week t, fit quantiles on revisions observed strictly before t; score empirical coverage and interval score on t+h outcomes by stratum
acceptance: 80% band coverage within [0.75, 0.85] in every major stratum over >=6 non-overlapping horizons, with mean width no worse than the depth-only baseline
rejection: Coverage error > 0.10 in any major stratum, or no width gain over the depth/season-only baseline (then ship the simpler baseline)
related_roadmap: C10-ML-01, AL-1, MATH_MODEL_CALIBRATION_POLICY section 2, AMATH-01 S3 (weekly analogue), MD-32
novelty_note: Uncertain novelty vs competitors: some dynasty sites show ranges of expert ranks; a calibrated forward revision band appears uncommon (SPECULATION)

title: Outcome-calibrate the five-axis confidence gate (reliability of buckets against later value revision)
current_system: B11 gate: independence (5/3 families), coverage/freshness/applicability/agreement (0.75/0.50 shares), agreement band 15%, overall = weakest axis
current_method: Deterministic thresholds; family counts derived from blend rungs (MECHANICALLY REQUIRED-ish); share ladder 0.75/0.5 and 0.15 band are stated PRIORS
evidence: config/confidence/gate_v1.json labels EVIDENCE_SHARE_HIGH 'A stated PRIOR, not a fit'; AGREEMENT_VALUE_RATIO borrowed from an /edge display threshold (p70 of market-gap). No reliability test against outcomes found in repo. AMATH D1 (scratchpad amath_val_d1.py; committed CSVs/site_raw via git show, t0 2026-07-20..09-14, h=28d, 8 offense sources) suggests the agreement idea is only weakly predictive of later revision.
baseline: Depth-only bucket (rank band) as a confidence proxy; current gate
proposed: Reliability study: for each bucket and each axis, P(|dlog value over h| > tau) and mean |dlog value|, by rank band; test whether each axis adds information beyond depth (likelihood-ratio / ordinal logit with depth control); simplify axes that add nothing
mechanism: A confidence label is a promise about stability/trustworthiness; without calibration it can be monotone in nothing. Ablation can REMOVE axes that do not discriminate
data_available: Historical boards rebuildable via src/api/value_replay.py; CSV git history
data_missing: Per-row historical confidence stamps are not in raw archives (needs replay rebuilds per date)
consumers: confidenceBucket on every row; Consensus Edge WITHHELD gating; /edge; trade displays
risk: Changing buckets changes what users trust; must be shadow first
evaluation: Rebuild boards weekly 2026-07..2026-10-20 (pre-sealing), compute buckets, score against t+28d revisions; non-overlapping folds
acceptance: HIGH bucket revision quantiles strictly below MEDIUM below LOW in >=80% of folds and the gate beats depth-only on proper score
rejection: Gate no better than depth-only -> simplify to depth + family count
related_roadmap: B11, C1-U5 confidence naming, C10 prior census, MD-32

title: Re-select or estimate the IDP/pick anchor shrinkage alpha=0.10; its selection rationale no longer exists
current_system: Hierarchical anchor + alpha-shrinkage (alpha=0.10) for IDP and pick rows
current_method: Fixed alpha chosen from a 2D alpha x lambda stability grid
evidence: reports/alpha_lambda_joint_backtest_full.md: metric = value-weighted rank change (stability), 25 snapshots 2026-03-23..04-16, optimum alpha=0 (degenerate single-anchor); alpha=0.10 picked as 'cheapest non-degenerate' at lambda=0.10. lambda was later set to 0.0 (_MAD_PENALTY_LAMBDA retired 2026-04-20), where alpha=0.10 scores 0.332 vs 0.149 optimum, so the chosen joint point no longer exists; pipeline, sources and anchors have changed since April.
baseline: alpha=0 excluded by product rule; equal treatment (no anchor hierarchy, plain count-aware blend as offense uses)
proposed: Empirical-Bayes shrinkage: alpha_row = tau^2 / (tau^2 + sigma_sub^2/n_sub) estimated from between-source variance per position/rank band, or a re-selected scalar under a predictive target (AM-VALUATION-05) rather than stability
mechanism: A stability metric is minimized by ignoring information; a fixed alpha cannot adapt to rows where the subgroup is large and agreeing vs small and noisy
data_available: CSV git history, export archives, value_replay
data_missing: Independent IDP target (every IDP-covering source votes; noted in CLAUDE.md blend-integrity section)
consumers: All IDP and market-priced pick values
risk: IDP values shift broadly; IDPTC anchor lineage with IDP Show (MD-21) complicates any target
evaluation: Leave-family-out future agreement (source_quality harness), IDP and PICK strata separately; pick markets currently not evaluable (G2[PICK] missing)
acceptance: Predictive loss improvement exceeding the harness materiality (champion MALE SE) with CI excluding 0 in IDP stratum
rejection: No predictive gain -> keep 0.10 but relabel PRIOR with the stability-history caveat
related_roadmap: C10 prior census, AL-1b, IDPV/IDPM rows, MD-5

title: Add a 'no outlier filter + count-aware weighted trimmed median' arm as the strong simple baseline for outlier-integrity V2
current_system: Per-player Hampel filter K=2.75, min n=4, floor K*MAD>=1000 Hill points; V2/V2.1 challenger held
status: live incumbent; V2 held (MORE RESEARCH REQUIRED)
current_method: Median/MAD rejection in value space before a robust trimmed blend
evidence: docs/sources/OUTLIER_V2_AND_IDPSHOW_COMPARISON_2026-11-01.md: incumbent rejects plausible votes (32 new rejections when DLF IDP released, IDP rows move up to 33.5%); with NO filter elite IDP rows barely move (Garrett 3,510 -> 3,505). K=2.75 and floor 1000 are heuristics from drop-rate audits (data_contract.py comments).
baseline: No filter + existing count-aware trimmed weighted median (already robust to one extreme per side at k>=5)
proposed: Evaluate A (incumbent), V2.1, and N (no filter, structural-invalidity checks only) on the preregistered H set when its Stage 4 opens; choose the simplest arm that passes
principle: KEEP/SIMPLIFY; robust statistics (the blend is already an M-type estimator)
mechanism: Stacking a rejection filter on a trimmed median double-penalizes dissent; the declared-range check already catches gross errors
data_available: Sealed H boards (after Stage 4), G2dev board
risk: Must not read sealed H boards early; no-filter arm may admit correlated wrong votes (known uncovered risk)
evaluation: Inside the existing V2.1 preregistered protocol only, as an added arm requires a new preregistration before H is read
acceptance: N arm meets every safety gate V2.1 must meet -> prefer N (fewer constants)
rejection: N fails injection-recovery gates that V2.1 passes
effort: S (1-2 days, piggybacks on V2.1 Stage 4)
related_roadmap: #1884, V2-3, Batch 2 Unit C, MD-5, D5

domain: A. Dynasty player valuation / L. Adaptive learning
title: Board drift forecast from stale votes (original): predict how the canonical value will move as lagging sources update
current_system: Freshness weighting down-weights stale votes; nothing forecasts the board's own predictable drift
current_method: Stale votes lose weight (information loss), fresh votes dominate
evidence: AMATH D2 (scratchpad amath_val_d2.py; same substrate as D1): over 28 days the non-KTC consensus moved toward KTC (median Spearman 0.145, positive in 9/9 overlapping windows, n~290 offense players per window) while KTC did not move toward the consensus (median 0.006). Consistent with the existing null for Consensus Edge mispricing (src/consensus_edge/score.py COMPONENT_VALIDATION, docs/measurements/consensus-edge-backtest-2026-08-04-h14.json).
evidence_class: DEMONSTRATED-IN-REPO (exploratory; ~3 effective independent windows; offense preseason only)
baseline: No forecast; or naive 'consensus converges to KTC fully' forecast
proposed: For each row, expected drift = sum over stale families of w_f * beta(age_f, band) * (fresh-reference gap); estimate beta by rolling walk-forward on CSV history; display as a labelled drift arrow, never added to value and never a vote
principle: 4 latent state / nowcasting; 6 dependence (the convergence is itself lineage evidence)
mechanism: If laggards predictably converge, the board's next move is partly forecastable; showing it prevents users from trading on a value that is mechanically about to change
risk: Importing KTC into other votes would break signal independence, so the forecast must stay display-only; owner consensus directive: similarity never merges votes
evaluation: Rolling origin; forecast vs realized board change over h; compare to zero-drift and full-convergence baselines
acceptance: Forecast beats zero-drift on MAE of board change in >= 5/6 non-overlapping folds
novelty_note: Uncertain novelty: no dynasty product known to the author forecasts its own consensus drift from source staleness (SPECULATION)
